close_reason: Marked opinion by SEC7: premise is factually incorrect (the value() calls in the None,None branch are first access, not redundant extraction)
description: In ava_values_match (line 567), when both any_to_str_bytes() calls return None (non-string tag), the fallback comparison re-extracts a.value() and b.value() that were already implicitly extracted during tag matching. Minor efficiency: both calls are O(1) but involve redundant field access. Consider storing values in ava_values_match() instead of re-extracting in fallback. Low impact for typical X.509 names (string-type AVAs predominate).
title: Minor: Redundant value() calls in ava_values_match fallback
